title: Non-ASCII text routes through the platform pipeline; CJK fallback face
statement: draw_text routes non-ASCII UTF-8 through TextShaper (UTF-8->FriBidi->HarfBuzz->FreeType); ASCII keeps the byte-identical BitmapFont path (90/90 fidelity invariant). Remaining .notdef CJK clusters resolve through the fonts.xml-style CJK fallback face (WenQuanYi Zen Hei) — never tofu, never a silent 0-pixel draw (F-153).

source.origin: AOSP fonts.xml fallback-chain law + Paint/TextPaint pipeline (android-14)
